plugins.name: airship
plugins.description: Airship SDK tools — push notifications, channels, migrations, RTDS, and wallet.

skills.name: channel-listing
skills.description: List all channels registered to an app key with pagination support. Channels are returned in sorted order by channel_id (UUID). Use when you need to retrieve multiple channels, export audience data, or perform bulk operations on channels.
skills.description_zh: 分页列出应用密钥下注册的所有 Airship 渠道，按 channel_id（UUID）排序；用于读取多渠道、导出受众数据或批量渠道操作。

skills.name: create-pipeline
skills.description: Create pipelines (automations) in Airship that trigger automated messages based on events like Custom Events, tag changes, app opens, and more. Use when setting up automated messaging workflows, creating event-triggered notifications, or building personalized automation sequences.
headings: Example 1: Simple Custom Event Trigger with Personalized Push
Example 2: Custom Event Trigger with Push and Message Center (Both Personalized)
skills.description_zh: 在 Airship 创建由自定义事件、标签变化、应用打开等触发自动消息的管道；用于自动消息流程、事件通知和个性化自动化序列。

skills.name: custom-events
skills.description: Submit custom events to Airship for user tracking, automation triggers, and audience segmentation. Use when tracking user actions, behaviors, or when events need to trigger automated messages and sequences.
headings: Example 3: Multiple Events in One Request
skills.description_zh: 向 Airship 提交自定义事件，用于用户行为跟踪、自动化触发及受众细分，也可让事件触发消息和序列。

skills.name: email-lookup
skills.description: Lookup an email channel by email address to check if it's registered, retrieve its channel_id, and get channel details. Use before registration or association operations.
skills.description_zh: 按邮箱地址查询 Airship 邮件渠道，检查是否已注册、获取 channel_id 和详情；用于注册或关联前核验。

skills.name: email-registration
skills.description: Register email addresses as channels in Airship. Use when onboarding users, importing email lists, or creating email channels for messaging. Returns a channel_id for use in workflows.
skills.description_zh: 在 Airship 将邮箱地址注册为渠道，用于用户入驻、导入邮件名单或建立消息渠道；返回可用于工作流的 channel_id。

skills.name: email-replace
skills.description: Replace an email channel with a new email address. Creates a new channel, associates it with the same user, and uninstalls the source channel. Use when updating a user's email address.
skills.description_zh: 用新邮箱替换 Airship 邮件渠道：创建新渠道、关联同一用户并卸载原渠道；用于更新用户邮箱。

skills.name: list-pipelines
skills.description: List pipelines (automations) in Airship with filtering by trigger type, enabled status, and other criteria. Use when discovering automations, checking pipeline configurations, or finding pipelines triggered by specific events like Custom Events.
headings: Example 2: List Pipelines with Custom Event Triggers
Example 3: List Enabled Pipelines with Pagination
skills.description_zh: 按触发类型、启用状态等条件列出 Airship 自动化管道，适用于发现自动化、核查配置或查找自定义事件等特定触发流程。

skills.name: named-users
skills.description: Associate channels (devices) with named users to create unified user profiles across multiple devices and channels. Use when linking devices to user accounts or coordinating messages across channels.
skills.description_zh: 将 Airship 渠道或设备关联至具名用户，建立跨设备跨渠道的统一画像；用于连接设备与账户及协调多渠道消息。

skills.name: open-channel-registration
skills.description: Register or update an Open Channel in Airship. Use when onboarding users to a custom delivery platform (e.g., WhatsApp, Slack, smart device) that is not backed by an Airship SDK. Returns a channel_id for use in push and named user workflows.
headings: Example 2: Registration with Identifiers and Tags
skills.description_zh: 在 Airship 注册或更新不由其 SDK 支持的自定义投递平台 Open Channel，如 WhatsApp、Slack 或智能设备；返回推送和具名用户工作流可用的 channel_id。

skills.name: push-notification
skills.description: Send push notifications to Airship audiences across multiple platforms including iOS, Android, Web, Email, and SMS. Use when the user wants to send notifications, alerts, or messages to users.
headings: Example 1: Simple Push to iOS Channel
skills.description_zh: 向 Airship 受众发送 iOS、Android、Web、邮件及短信等多平台推送；适用于用户要求发送通知、警报或消息。

skills.name: reports
skills.description: Read-only access to Airship Reports for delivery stats, send history, app activity, and A/B test outcomes. Use when answering "how did this push do?", "how is the app doing this week?", or any insight question that maps to /api/reports/*.
skills.description_zh: 只读访问 Airship Reports 的投递统计、发送历史、应用活动及 A/B 测试结果，回答推送效果、应用周表现或对应 /api/reports/* 的洞察问题。

skills.name: sms-lookup
skills.description: Lookup an SMS channel by phone number (msisdn) and sender to check if it's registered, retrieve its channel_id, and get channel details. Use before registration or association operations.
skills.description_zh: 按手机号（msisdn）与发送方查询 Airship 短信渠道，检查注册状态、获取 channel_id 与详情；用于注册或关联前核验。

skills.name: sms-registration
skills.description: Register SMS phone numbers as channels in Airship. Use when onboarding users, importing phone lists, or creating SMS channels for messaging. Returns a channel_id for use in workflows.
skills.description_zh: 在 Airship 将手机号注册为短信渠道，用于用户入驻、导入电话名单或建立短信消息渠道；返回工作流可用的 channel_id。

skills.name: tags
skills.description: Add, remove, or set tags on named users or channels for audience segmentation and targeting. Use when organizing users into groups, creating segments, or managing user metadata.
skills.description_zh: 给 Airship 具名用户或渠道添加、删除或设置标签，用于受众分组、细分、定向投递和用户元数据管理。

skills.name: custom-views
skills.description: Register custom native views for Airship Thomas scenes. Use when customizing Message Center, Preference Center, In-App Messages, or creating custom UI components for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, or Cordova.
skills.description_zh: 为 Airship Thomas 场景注册自定义原生视图，用于定制消息中心、偏好中心、应用内消息或开发 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Capacitor、Cordova UI 组件。

skills.name: message-center
skills.description: Implement Airship Message Center (app inbox). Use when adding an inbox to your app, customizing message list UI, or troubleshooting message delivery.
skills.description_zh: 实现 Airship 消息中心（应用收件箱），用于添加收件箱、定制消息列表 UI 或排查消息投递。

skills.name: migration
skills.description: Migrate Airship SDK to a newer version. Use when upgrading SDK versions, fixing deprecation warnings, or updating after a major SDK release.
skills.description_zh: 将 Airship SDK 迁移到新版本，用于升级、解决弃用警告或适配大版本发布。

skills.name: push
skills.description: Implement and test Airship push notifications. Use when setting up push notifications, troubleshooting delivery issues, or testing push integration on iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, or Cordova.
skills.description_zh: 实现并测试 Airship 推送通知，适用于在 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Capacitor 或 Cordova 配置推送、排查投递及测试集成。

skills.name: sdk-reference
skills.description: Airship SDK and API documentation. Use when helping with Airship push notifications, Message Center, Preference Center, In-App Messaging, or SDK integration for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Capacitor, or Cordova.
skills.description_zh: 提供 Airship SDK 和 API 文档参考，用于推送、消息中心、偏好中心、应用内消息，以及 iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Capacitor 或 Cordova SDK 集成。

skills.name: rtds-connection
skills.description: Connect to Airship's Real-Time Data Streaming (RTDS) API to consume event streams with filtering capabilities. Use when monitoring user interactions, push delivery, custom events, or building real-time integrations.
skills.description_zh: 连接 Airship 实时数据流 RTDS API，以过滤条件消费事件流；用于监控用户互动、推送投递、自定义事件和构建实时集成。

skills.name: update-wallet-pass
skills.description: Update fields on a wallet pass using an external ID. Use when updating pass information like values, labels, locations, or beacons for Apple Wallet or Google Pay passes.
skills.description_zh: 通过外部 ID 更新 Apple Wallet 或 Google Pay 钱包通行证字段，包括值、标签、位置和信标。

skills.name: app-activity-summary
skills.description: Answer "how is the app doing this week or month?" — the weekly or monthly digest pattern with Total Sends, Total App Opens, Net Opt-in Change, and current Opted-in Device Count. Mirrors the dashboard's App Metrics + Devices Engagement Reports view. Use when asked for an app-health snapshot over a date range.
headings: Step 7: Format the answer per the output contract
skills.description_zh: 按周、月或指定日期范围汇总应用健康，报告发送总数、应用打开总数、净订阅变化及当前已订阅设备数，对应仪表板的 App Metrics 与 Devices Engagement Reports。

skills.name: complete-user-onboarding
skills.description: Complete user onboarding workflow that registers multiple channels (email and SMS), associates them with a named user, tracks completion with a custom event, and sends a welcome notification. Use when onboarding new users, setting up multi-channel user accounts, or automating welcome sequences.
headings: Step 3: Associate Email with Named User
Step 4: Associate SMS with Named User
skills.description_zh: 完成多渠道用户入驻：注册邮件和短信渠道、关联具名用户，以自定义事件记录完成并发送欢迎通知。用于新用户、多渠道账户和欢迎序列自动化。

skills.name: create-custom-event-automation
skills.description: Create an automation (pipeline) triggered by Custom Events that sends personalized push notifications and Message Center messages. The messages use handlebars templating to access Custom Event properties, value, and name for personalization. Use when setting up event-triggered messaging, creating personalized automation sequences, or building Custom Event-driven workflows.
headings: Step 1: Define Custom Event Trigger Criteria
Step 2: Identify Custom Event Properties for Personalization
Step 3: Create Personalized Push Notification Content
Step 4: Create Personalized Message Center Content
Example: Complete Pipeline with All Features
skills.description_zh: 创建由自定义事件触发的 Airship 管道，发送个性化推送和消息中心消息；通过 handlebars 模板读取事件属性、值及名称。用于事件消息和个性化自动流程。

skills.name: custom-event-automation-discovery
skills.description: Discover all automations (pipelines) triggered by Custom Events and create sample Custom Events that would trigger them. This workflow extracts trigger criteria and handlebars template requirements to generate complete test events. Use when testing automations, documenting event requirements, or understanding pipeline configurations.
headings: Step 1: List Pipelines with Custom Event Triggers
Step 2: Extract Custom Event Criteria from Triggers
Step 2a: Extract Handlebars References from Pipeline Outcome
Example 2: Complex Trigger with Multiple Properties
skills.description_zh: 发现所有由自定义事件触发的 Airship 管道，提取触发条件和 handlebars 模板要求，生成可触发它们的完整示例事件；用于自动化测试、事件要求文档及理解配置。

skills.name: download-entire-audience
skills.description: Download an entire audience by leveraging parallel pagination across UUID prefixes. Uses 16 parallel threads, each handling channels starting with a different hex digit (0-9, a-f). Use when you need to export all channels, perform bulk operations, or synchronize channel data.
headings: all_results now contains the entire audience
skills.description_zh: 按 UUID 首位十六进制字符划分分页，用 16 个并行线程下载完整受众；用于导出全部渠道、批量操作或同步渠道数据。

skills.name: extract-unique-tags-and-attributes
skills.description: Extract a metadata-only JSON object of unique tags grouped by tag group (including synthetic device_tags), unique attribute keys, unique device attribute keys, and unique subscription lists from audience data. Use when you need a taxonomy catalog without exporting audience identities.
headings: Extract Unique Tags and Attributes Workflow
Step 5: Validate Output Safety and Completeness
skills.description_zh: 从受众数据提取仅含元数据的 JSON：按标签组分类的唯一标签（含合成 device_tags）、属性键、设备属性键及订阅列表；用于建立分类目录而不导出受众身份。

skills.name: open-channel-middleware
skills.description: Build a proof-of-concept middleware server that bridges a custom delivery platform (e.g., WhatsApp, Slack) to Airship Open Channels. Generates working code for GCP Cloud Run or AWS Lambda that handles inbound channel registration, Airship webhook validation, and push payload delivery. Use when a customer or technical resource needs to stand up an Open Channels integration quickly.
headings: Step 3 — Send a push via Airship API
skills.description_zh: 生成连接 WhatsApp、Slack 等自定义投递平台与 Airship Open Channels 的概念验证中间件，提供可在 GCP Cloud Run 或 AWS Lambda 运行的代码，处理渠道注册、Airship webhook 校验及推送载荷投递；用于快速建立集成。

skills.name: purchase-to-pass-update
skills.description: Event-driven workflow where in-store purchases trigger wallet pass updates. POS system emits custom events with named users, RTDS listener filters for purchase events, and updates pass points. Use when integrating POS systems with wallet passes, building loyalty programs, or implementing real-time pass updates.
headings: Part A: POS System - Emit Purchase Event
Step 2: Correlate Email with Named User
Part B: RTDS Listener - Process Events and Update Pass
Step 4: Connect to RTDS with Custom Event Filter
Step 6: Map Named User to Pass External ID
First check if pass_external_id is in event properties
skills.description_zh: 构建门店购买触发钱包通行证更新的事件流程：POS 发出带具名用户的自定义事件，RTDS 监听器筛选购买事件并更新积分。用于 POS 与钱包集成、忠诚度计划及实时更新。

skills.name: push-performance-analysis
skills.description: Answer "how did this push or campaign do?" with dashboard-aligned metrics — Sends, Direct Opens, Direct Open Rate, Influenced Opens, Influenced Open Rate, and per-platform breakdown. Discovers the push by name or send-time hint when no push_id is given. Handles A/B variant breakdown automatically.
headings: Step 5: Format the answer per the output contract
skills.name_hint: push · 性能/表现 · 分析
skills.description_zh: 以与仪表板一致的发送数、直接打开数及率、受影响打开数及率和平台拆分评估推送或活动效果；未给 push_id 时按名称或发送时间线索查找，自动拆分 A/B 变体。

skills.name: register-associate-email
skills.description: Register an email address as a channel and associate it with a named user. The registration endpoint handles both new and existing channels automatically. Use when onboarding users, integrating with CRM systems, or bulk importing users.
skills.description_zh: 注册邮件渠道并关联具名用户，注册接口自动处理新旧渠道；用于用户入驻、CRM 集成或批量导入。

skills.name: register-associate-sms
skills.description: Register an SMS phone number as a channel and associate it with a named user. The registration endpoint handles both new and existing channels automatically. Use when onboarding users, integrating with CRM systems, or bulk importing users.
skills.description_zh: 注册短信手机号渠道并关联具名用户，注册接口自动处理新旧渠道；用于用户入驻、CRM 集成或批量导入。

skills.name: replace-email-address
skills.description: Replace an email channel with a new email address. Looks up the current email channel, then replaces it with a new address while preserving user association. Use when updating a user's email address.
skills.description_zh: 先查询现有邮件渠道，再替换成新邮箱并保留用户关联；用于更新用户邮箱地址。

skills.name: rtds-monitoring
skills.description: Connect to Real-Time Data Streaming API to monitor events, process them, and handle reconnection using offset tracking. Enables real-time monitoring of push delivery, custom events, and user interactions. Use when building real-time integrations, monitoring systems, or event-driven applications.
skills.description_zh: 连接 RTDS 实时数据流，监控和处理事件，通过偏移量跟踪处理断线重连；用于推送投递、自定义事件、用户互动监控及实时或事件驱动集成。
